description: Service split for the ovh provider. Ordered rules (JavaScript regex against the qualified path: the vendor path prefixed with the API version, e.g. /v1/cloud/project/{serviceName}/instance), first match wins; every operation path must match a rule or bin/split.mjs and build_inventory.mjs fail without writing. Each rule names the service, the naming prefix stripped before resource names are derived ("prefix"), the resource the prefix itself maps to ("root", needed only when a path equals the prefix or the prefix plus one parameter) and, for Public Cloud project paths, the scope ("scope", a key of SCOPES in lib/spec_helpers.mjs and of servers.json) whose server template carries the project variable. One service per API family; the two Public Cloud families are sub-split by product. "services" carries the title and description written into each service document. A rule with "excluded": true classifies the path for the inventory but the service is never emitted.
